hat_crown.reason: Increase width from 0.72 to 0.80 to fit head circumference with brim sitting snugly across skull top.

hat_explorer.reason: Reduce dy from 0.28 to 0.12 so brim does not sink down covering the monster eyes; w 1.00 fits full head width.

hat_scholar.reason: Slightly wider base (w 0.95) to balance the mortarboard flat cap over monster heads.

hat_wizard.reason: Adjust dy from 0.22 to 0.20 and w 0.90 for cone hat brim to rest directly on head crest.

glasses_round.reason: Switch base to eyeSpan with w 1.85 so each round lens covers the eye with a 10% outer margin across all eye shapes.

glasses_goggles.reason: Switch base to eyeSpan with w 1.85 so goggles strap and lens align evenly with eye centers.

outfit_scarf.reason: Adjust dy from -0.22 to -0.15 so scarf folds wrap collar seam without overlapping into lower mouth.

outfit_vest.reason: Switch base to bodyWidth (w 0.68) so vest fits torso width without hanging past the belly like a giant coat.

outfit_hoodie.reason: Switch base to bodyWidth (w 0.78) for cozy sweater fit across chest with hood collar at chin.

outfit_cape.reason: Switch base to bodyWidth (w 1.70) so cape spreads wide behind shoulders and flanks rather than getting hidden behind chibi head.

bp_explorer.reason: Increase w to 1.60 and shift dy to -0.65 so pack body and top straps peek out visibly past large chibi head.

bp_book.reason: Increase w to 1.60 and shift dy to -0.65 to ensure backpack flanks are visible behind torso.

bp_miniwings.reason: Increase w to 1.70 and dy to -0.65 so mini wingtips spread out beyond shoulder contours.

bp_adventure.reason: Increase w to 1.60 and dy to -0.65 so pack handles and rolled mat emerge behind neck/head.
